entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3736865265441207424: position at J2016.0. Distance: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 113226: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 29.76 +/- 0.14 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b): 33.602 +/- 0.158 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 30.2110 +/- 0.1907 mas (same row, RUWE 2.44), 158.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -273.793, 19.804 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3736865265441207424 (quality A), from 2015A&A...574A..50J; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 11.98 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 113226: radius 11.98 +/- 0.07 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 3.318 +/- 0.013 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b). Mass 2.96 +/- 0.09 solar masses from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 113226: mass 2.96 +/- 0.09 solar masses (Table 6), from the PARAM Bayesian fit to PARSEC isochrones at the measured temperature; the paper calls its masses estimates only (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b). Temperature 5020 +/- 64 K from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 113226: effective temperature 5020 +/- 64 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit.

(1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Vindemiatrix is HR 4932., cross-checked against Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. * eps Vir is HR 4932. entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,020 K and log g 2.75 (u1 0.622, u2 0.152): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
